title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Minor Children attending Fard Salah in Mosque 3269 views Q. Assalam O Alaikum, This is regarding my previous question (Fatwa ID 13871). My earlier question was whether it is allowed or not to use illegal water and electricity in a Masjid. Illegal means theft of electricity and water. you answered that it is a sinful act. Now my further question is whether it is allowed for us (muqtadis) to offer the prayer in such place of worship where the water and electricity used is illegal. Please reply us soon. We muqtadis are unable to pay bills for water and electricity because here Mutawalli is a very corrupt man. He sells electricity to the tenants from the Masjid. And these tenants use heaters and other appliances very carelessly. 2237 views Q. Is it permissible in Islam to collect monthly salary for Imam of a Masjid who have a limited source of income from muqtadi and the neighboring residents of a masjid? 7351 views Q. Kya kahte hain Ulma-e-Kiram is baare mein --- 1. So we want to know that can this Eidgaah be sold and another land can be bought. Or can it be exchanged with another land? Please reply soon. It is an urgent Mas?alah. 2960 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 35522 Country: India Title: I am a committee member of a Masjid. In the meeting it was pointed out that the Imam and the Naib Imam are frequently absent in the namaz, therefore causing inconvenience to the muqtadis Question: I am a committee member of a Masjid. In the meeting it was pointed out that the Imam and the Naib Imam are frequently absent in the namaz, therefore causing inconvenience to the muqtadis. Therefore, one of the committee members started taking attendance of the Imams. The Imams then pointed out that it was wrong to take the attendance of the Imams according to the Shariah. Please inform the correct Shariah for the management of the mosque. Answer ID: 35522 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2046/1234/D=1432) Imamah or employment on salary is the matter of Ijarah. Hence now the matter of causal leave, sick leave and annual leave etc should be settles in the dealing clearly. Then it is right to take attendance for good management. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
